purpose: Make the independently reviewed IAM Simulator limitation explicit in the next bounded integration window without weakening ALB creation, function or cleanup gates.

source.owner_directive: A post-create listener or listener-rule tag-mutation denial is receipted as a non-fatal warning because the ALB works without post-create tag edits.

prerequisites_before_non_fatal_classific: creation-time listener and rule tagging completed or the resources were created with the required exact tags
the exact B6 internal ALB exists with its reviewed security group
the isolated Fargate readyz probe returns success
always_fatal: a denial for any action outside the four exact pairs
a denial for another account, region, load-balancer name or resource type
missing or malformed operation, error code, resource ARN or timestamp
missing exact internal ALB, listener, healthy target or isolated readyz proof
cleanup DeleteRule, DeleteListener, DeleteTargetGroup or DeleteLoadBalancer denial
